description: This file contains various search query functions for retrieving data related to employees, leads, customers, suppliers, items, BOMs, projects, delivery notes, batches, accounts, manufacturer info, purchase receipts/invoices, and tax templates within an ERP system. These functions are intended to be used as web-exposed endpoints (via frappe.whitelist) for implementing dynamic search functionalities in the ERPNext application.

methods.name: employee_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Performs search for active or suspended employees based on search text and filters.

methods.name: lead_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves leads not yet converted, filtered by search text and match conditions.

methods.name: customer_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Searches for customers based on customer details and user default preferences.

methods.name: supplier_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Searches for suppliers matching the search text and additional filters.

methods.name: tax_account_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Fetches tax-related accounts matching search criteria within a specified company and currency.

methods.name: item_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters, as_dict=False)
methods.description: Performs comprehensive item search, considering filters like customer or supplier, and returns item details.

methods.name: bom(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Searches for Bill of Materials (BOM) entries based on search input.

methods.name: get_project_name(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves project names based on search input and optional customer filter.

methods.name: get_delivery_notes_to_be_billed(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters, as_dict)
methods.description: Fetches delivery notes near billing, filtered by search text, status, and other conditions.

methods.name: get_batch_no(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves batch numbers for an item, optionally filtered by posting date and other parameters.

methods.name: get_account_list(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Lists accounts filtered by doctype, search text, and additional filters.

methods.name: get_blanket_orders(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves blanket order records matching specified item, type, and company filters.

methods.name: get_income_account(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Searches for income accounts relevant to a given company or filters.

methods.name: get_filtered_dimensions(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves dimensional filters applicable to accounts and other doctype based on user input.

methods.name: get_expense_account(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Searches for expense or asset accounts matching filters.

methods.name: warehouse_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Queries warehouses with optional filters, including bin and stock quantity info.

methods.name: get_batch_numbers(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves batch IDs filtered by expiry date and item code.

methods.name: item_manufacturer_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Searches for item manufacturers based on manufacturer name and item code.

methods.name: get_purchase_receipts(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Fetches purchase receipt records matching search text and item filters.

methods.name: get_purchase_invoices(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves purchase invoices matching search text and item filters.

methods.name: get_tax_template(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax templates for an item considering item group taxes and valid dates.

methods.name: get_fields(doctype, fields=None)
methods.description: Gets search fields for a given doctype, including title field if present.

methods.name: get_accounts(with_account_type_filter)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: get_doctype_wise_filters(filters)
methods.description: unavailable
